episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: William and Ingrid look forward to meeting Jay's new girlfriend, Anna. But before their formal introduction, William and Anna lock eyes — and sparks fly.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As their passion intensifies, Anna establishes rules for William to follow, only for his resolve to be tested when she goes to Paris with Jay.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Feeling on edge after receiving mysterious text messages during Anna and Jay's engagement party, William soon slips up. Sally makes a confession.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The walls begin to close in on William and Anna before a tragic event changes everything. Anna's mother admits to a shocking secret about the past.
